extracted text: The paper studies the aluminum alloy 6061-T6 and compares it with a steel of comparable yield strength, S25C. The 6061-T6 exhibits plasticity-induced fatigue crack closure (PIFCC), while the steel exhibits roughness-induced fatigue crack closure (RIFCC). The 6061-T6 was one of the two alloys used in experiments to determine why some alloys display PIFCC whereas other alloys display RIFCC.
